name: ef_priority_filter
description: 17 test 9: two descriptions named x, with priorities 1 and 3. With max priority 2, x resolves to the priority-1 one. With max priority 3 or 5, to the priority-3 one. With max priority 0 no description qualifies (0 < p is never satisfied), so the index is -1 and the call still succeeds -- and an effect with index -1 never posts its end message (4.1 quirk). Ties are broken by the first entry met in the name map.

steps.note: a tie is broken by name-map order: the first entry met wins
steps.name: x
